record.original_question: Is B Γ̄q 2q-connected i.e. do πi (B Γ̄q ) vanish for all i ≤ 2q?

evidence.quote: Question 9.1 (“Haefliger-Thurston conjecture”). Is B Γ̄q 2q-connected i.e. do πi (B Γ̄q ) vanish for all i ≤ 2q?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q$ be a positive integer. A codimension-$q$ Haefliger structure on a topological space $X$ is, informally, a maximal atlas of local submersions to $\mathbb{R}^q$ together with germs of holonomy transition diffeomorphisms. The (smooth) Haefliger groupoid $\Gamma_q$ is the topological groupoid whose objects form $\mathbb{R}^q$ and whose morphisms are germs of locally defined $C^\infty$ diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{R}^q$, with the sheaf (germ) topology. Its classifying space $B\Gamma_q$ classifies codimension-$q$ Haefliger structures up to concordance.

There is a natural map $
u : B\Gamma_q 	o BO(q)$ classifying the normal bundle of a Haefliger structure. Let $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$ denote the homotopy fiber of $
u$; equivalently, $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$ is the classifying space of codimension-$q$ Haefliger structures equipped with a trivialization of the normal bundle (framed Haefliger structures).

It is a classical theorem that $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$ is $q$-connected, and (Mather–Thurston / Tsuboi type results) that $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$ is in fact $(2q-1)$-connected when smooth structures of class $C^\infty$ are used, for the strongest currently known degree of connectivity in some settings.

Problem. Determine whether $B\overline{\Gamma}_q$ is $2q$-connected; that is, decide whether
$$\pi_i(B\overline{\Gamma}_q) = 0 \quad 	ext{for all } i \le 2q.$$
artifact.status_search_result: This is the long-standing Haefliger–Thurston conjecture on the connectivity of the classifying space of framed codimension-$q$ Haefliger structures. It remains open in general; partial progress (e.g., proofs of $(2q-1)$-connectivity, and results in special cases or under PL/topological hypotheses) has been made, but $2q$-connectivity has not been established.

status_evidence.title: On the Haefliger-Thurston conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Concerns the conjecture that B\bar{Gamma}_q is 2q-connected; establishes partial results.
status_evidence.claim: The Haefliger-Thurston conjecture asserting 2q-connectivity of B\bar{Gamma}_q is the subject of ongoing investigation, with partial progress but no full proof.

status_evidence.title: Proof of a conjecture of A. Haefliger (Tsuboi)
status_evidence.snippet: Classifying space for framed Haefliger structures of codimension q is (2q-1)-connected for C^r, 1<=r<=infty.
status_evidence.claim: Known results give (2q-1)-connectivity, one degree short of the conjectured 2q-connectivity.
